answer: A post-loss bond defeats sybils. Each agent stakes before attesting; if its votes diverge from the cohort majority, that stake is slashed and paid to honest signers. An operator with ten thousand keys pays ten thousand bonds, yet copies cannot vote in step, since each vote is scored against a randomized peer sample, so the swarm becomes a noisy mirror of itself and loses. Honest agents reclaim their bond plus yield, so real work stays profitable while fakes burn capital. A shared unpredictable seed acts as a prism refracting honest proofs, while a lone raven mimicking the flock is unmasked.
